10k.note: 10-K is a dental devices and technologies disclosure (Connected Technology Solutions, Essential Dental Solutions, Orthodontic and Implant Solutions, Wellspect Healthcare). No proprietary therapeutic drug pipeline disclosed.

website.error: Pure dental medtech / consumables; company has no biopharma 'pipeline' page. Did not fetch.

ctgov.note: Only 3 ClinicalTrials.gov records mention Dentsply Sirona. None are sponsored by Dentsply Sirona (sponsors are University of Illinois at Chicago, Nationwide Children's Hospital, and Marcio Zaffalon Casati - investigator-initiated). All three are COMPLETED, WITHDRAWN, or UNKNOWN status.

commercial_product.note: Dentsply Sirona is the world's largest manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies. Reporting segments: Connected Technology Solutions (CBCT and 2D imaging, CAD/CAM systems including Primescan / CEREC, treatment centers, instruments), Essential Dental Solutions (endodontic instruments and obturation, restorative consumables, preventive products), Orthodontic and Implant Solutions (SureSmile clear aligners, Byte direct-to-consumer aligners, Astra Tech / Ankylos / Atlantis dental implants and prosthetics), and Wellspect Healthcare (LoFric intermittent catheters and Navina bowel-care products). All approved/marketed devices and consumables - out of scope for an active P1/P2/P3 drug pipeline.

excluded_legacy_terminated: All three ClinicalTrials.gov records that mention Dentsply Sirona are COMPLETED, WITHDRAWN or UNKNOWN-status investigator-initiated studies and are excluded from the active pipeline.
excluded_partner_owned: All three ClinicalTrials.gov records are investigator-initiated studies sponsored by academic centers (University of Illinois at Chicago; Nationwide Children's Hospital; an individual investigator) - not Dentsply Sirona-sponsored programs.
